$comment: Owner: hep-statistics. Typed fields of a statistical-result since contracts 2.6.0, applied by contracts.validate on top of ext_statistical_result.json and ext_statistical_result_v2_2.json only to artifacts of contract 2.6.0 or later, or to older ones with --strict. All optional. Semantic rules: contracts.validate._stat_hardening.

seeds.$comment: since 2.6.0: the seeds of every toy ensemble the result rests on (for example {"toys": 1, "coverage": 2}); a toy-based construction, coverage, goodness of fit or significance without them is unresolved (stats.seed_missing)

seed.$comment: since 2.6.0: the seed of the coverage toys (alternative to extension.seeds)

convention.$comment: since 2.6.0: the z/p convention; default one-sided, z = Phi^-1(1 - p)
